question: How many components of population change are there which are core to the domain of population studies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are **3 core components** of population change in population studies.
 
• These components are **birth rate, death rate, and migration.**
 
• The **birth rate** refers to the number of live births per 1,000 people in a year.
 
• The **death rate** refers to the number of deaths per 1,000 people in a year.
 
• **Migration** includes both immigration (people moving into an area) and emigration (people moving out of an area).
 
• Understanding these components helps in analyzing population growth and demographic changes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The study of population change is crucial for planning and policy-making in areas such as **healthcare, education, and housing.**
 
• Population studies also help in understanding the **socio-economic impacts** of population changes.
 
• Data on birth rates, death rates, and migration are typically collected through **censuses and surveys**.
 
• Changes in population can have significant effects on **economic development and resource allocation.**
 
• Population dynamics are influenced by a variety of factors including **economic conditions, cultural norms, and government policies.**
